title: C++: Template Metaprogramming
description: Use template metaprogramming to compute values at compile time.

steps.title: Compile-time Factorial
steps.description: Create a template struct Factorial<N> with a static const value = N * Factorial<N-1>::value, and specialization Factorial<0>::value = 1. Print Factorial<5>::value and Factorial<7>::value at runtime (they're computed at compile time).
hints: template<int N> struct Factorial { static const int value = N * Factorial<N-1>::value; };
template<> struct Factorial<0> { static const int value = 1; };
